notes: Per-edition version tracking. Banner is now edition-aware: when your edition has an update it shows 'ViperTab[ Dev] vX.Y.Z available' (gold/green badge); when only the OTHER edition was bumped it shows an informational 'New ViperTab[ Dev] vX.Y.Z dropped — try it' (cyan badge). release.sh now accepts an optional edition arg (main/dev/both) for single-edition releases.
